mechanism: Both agents cause vasodilation and reduce blood pressure through different mechanisms; chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion (potassium, sodium) while lisinopril increases potassium retention, creating opposing effects on serum potassium and requiring careful monitoring.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium), renal function, and blood pressure regularly; adjust doses based on clinical response and lab values; educate patient on dietary sodium/potassium intake.
